To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a novel method to analyze large amounts of gene microarray data, which finds millions of relationships between genes, that these relationships are preserved across all species, and that the relationships are consistent with the known biology.

we have developed a method for finding Boolean implications from gene expression data that finds millions of implications that are not found by other methods and that capture gender, tissue, development, and species differences.
we have developed a method for finding if-then relationships between genes in large microarray datasets and have found millions of relationships that would otherwise be missed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new methods and algorithms that will allow us to better understand the relationships between genes and gene expression.
the extraction of biological knowledge from very large amounts of high dimensional data.
the discovery of gene expression networks that can be used to predict the expression levels of genes in response to perturbations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Boolean implication networks derived from very large scale, whole-genome, gene expression datasets are a valuable source of information about the structure of the underlying gene regulatory network.
the Boolean implication networks are a very rich resource that can be used to understand the relationships between gene expression in a wide variety of conditions and species.
the method presented here can discover a very large amount of information in a single pass over the microarray data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data from the microarray experiments are consistent with a large number of simple Boolean rules.
Boolean implications are a powerful method for discovering gene relationships from microarray data.
the Boolean implications derived from microarray data are an excellent source for new knowledge about the genes that regulate development, tissue, and species specific differences.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Boolean implications are a useful and robust way to analyze gene expression data.
the Boolean implications are very useful for understanding the data.
the gene expression data from thousands of experiments can be combined into a single network of implications that is much more comprehensive than any individual experiment.
